nodes.label: Financial Reporting, Audit & Shareholder Communications
nodes.summary: Financial reporting obligations, audit requirements, preliminary results announcements, annual and interim reports, shareholder meetings, and communication requirements.

nodes.label: Annual and Interim Reporting
nodes.summary: Listed companies must publish annual and interim financial reports within prescribed timeframes. Annual reports must be dispatched within 4 months of financial year-end.

nodes.label: MBL Rule 13.40 — Annual Report Deadline
nodes.summary: Annual report must be dispatched within 4 months of the end of the financial year.

nodes.label: MBL Rule 13.41 — Interim Report Deadline
nodes.summary: Interim report must be published within 2 months of the end of the interim period.

nodes.label: Companies Ordinance s.359 — Financial Reporting
nodes.summary: Companies must prepare annual financial statements in accordance with accounting standards.

nodes.label: Preliminary Results Announcement
nodes.summary: Listed companies must publish preliminary results announcements before publishing the full annual report. The announcement must contain sufficient information for investors.

nodes.label: MBL Rule 13.49 — Preliminary Announcement
nodes.summary: Preliminary results announcement must be published as soon as reasonably practicable after the board approves the financial statements.

nodes.label: Audit Committee Responsibilities
nodes.summary: The audit committee must oversee the relationship with external auditors, review financial statements, and monitor internal controls and risk management.

nodes.label: AGM / EGM / Voting / Poll
nodes.summary: Listed companies must hold an AGM within 6 months of the financial year-end. EGMs may be convened as needed. Poll voting is required for certain resolutions.

nodes.label: MBL Rule 13.39 — AGM Requirements
nodes.summary: AGM must be held within 6 months of the end of the financial year.

nodes.label: Companies Ordinance s.584 — AGM Requirements
nodes.summary: Companies must hold an AGM within 6 months of the end of the financial year.

nodes.label: Annual Report Dispatch and Shareholder Communication
nodes.summary: Listed companies must dispatch annual and interim reports to shareholders. The reports must be available on the company's website and the HKEX website.

nodes.label: MBL Rule 13.44 — Report Dispatch
nodes.summary: Annual and interim reports must be dispatched to shareholders at least 21 days before the AGM or EGM.

nodes.label: MBL Rule 13.45 — Website Publication
nodes.summary: Annual and interim reports must be published on the company's website and the HKEX website.

nodes.label: Profit Warning
nodes.summary: Listed companies must issue a profit warning if there is a reasonable possibility of a significant change in profit compared to the previous period. The warning must be issued as soon as practicable.

nodes.label: MBL Rule 13.09 — Profit Warning
nodes.summary: A listed company must issue a profit warning if there is a reasonable possibility of a significant change in profit.

nodes.label: Preliminary Results Announcement
nodes.summary: Step 1: Prepare and publish preliminary annual or interim results announcement within the applicable Listing Rule timetable.

nodes.label: Audit and Board Approval
nodes.summary: Step 2: Complete audit committee review, board approval, and audit sign-off where required.

nodes.label: Dispatch Annual or Interim Report
nodes.summary: Step 3: Dispatch reports and publish them on the issuer and HKEX websites.

nodes.label: AGM and Shareholder Communication
nodes.summary: Step 4: Convene AGM or relevant shareholder meeting and maintain ongoing shareholder communications.
